data.name: Glow Up Agency
data.detailed_description:
YOUR DOUBLE LIFE AWAITS

We're taking the time needed to ensure DOUBLE LIFE runs smoothly from the moment you open your salon doors. Quality over speed. Wishlist now and be notified when we're ready!


About the Game

DOUBLE LIFE: Luxury Salon Management & Dirty Money Mystery

Run your salon and solve a murder. Balance client flow, train staff, keep the books. Sell suspects' secrets, launder money, and try to stay one step ahead. Your choices shape your story.

TROPICAL CHAOS: Ragdoll Control & Life With Two Phones

You’re not a wellness icon or beauty guru : you opened this place for profit. Now the island is shaken by a murder and every client is a suspect. You’re suddenly managing more secrets than appointments. The President calls, clients act strange, and ragdoll physics turn every stumble and spill into potential evidence.

Loop: Open salon → Take clients → Balance the books → Sell/negotiation secrets → Launder dirty money.

OPERATIONS & MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

Build your business on a grid-based layout. Optimize flows, boost tips with decor and room synergies. Hair, skin, massage. Chase trends and maximize profit with the right deals. Each employee has a skill tree (Speed/Quality/Upselling). Balance shifts, avoid burnout, and protect your reputation.

CRIME, MYSTERY & SHADY DECISIONS

Clients talk, you listen. The President wants intel and offers dirty money. Every choice has consequences. Launder money through ghost clients and fake events. Try to dodge inspections. A different killer and fresh story each run. Collect clues from your clients and piece together the truth.

OTHER UNIQUE MECHANICS

RAGDOLL PHYSICS: Even when you trip and scatter objects, the salon has to keep running.

FLYING ASSISTANT: A customizable assistant that gathers hints, reminds you of leads, and reacts to your decisions.

CONCLUSION

Remember: every decision leaves a trace. The story and the fallout are yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard required. Gamepad not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smoother experience.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains a murder mystery investigation with crime scene elements. Some characters use alcohol and illegal drugs, and players may face moral choices involving these substances. The game includes a dating app feature for romantic interactions (no explicit content). Players will encounter ethical dilemmas involving corruption and criminal activity. No graphic violence or sexual content is shown.
